This is my sorghum plot, small but it feeds the family. I have some schooling and I know the cooperative brings DAP and urea, but sorghum doesn't take fertilizer like wheat does, and the rains here can be unreliable, so I won't waste money on a heavy dose. I'll put a little chemical fertilizer at planting and add manure from my animals, which is what my father did. The seed I save from last year is good enough — improved sorghum seed is hard to find and costs too much. My wife and older children will help me weed, and I'll hire a few neighbors for the harvest days.
